request.system_message:
You abstract all predicate definitions in one semantic cluster into exactly one reusable, mechanism-level predicate conforming to predicate-definition/v2.

Read every member's complete definition, ordered parameters, assertion conditions, and exclusion conditions. Identify the shared underlying behavioral mechanism. Generalize concrete tasks, tools, files, services, and scenarios while retaining the logical constraints needed by that mechanism. Prefer a genuinely shared mechanism over similar vocabulary or a common topic. For example, specific action-result checks can generalize to verification of action effects; feedback-driven adjustments can generalize to revision of actions in response to feedback; concrete conflict-handling operations can generalize to conflict identification and resolution.

Cover the common semantics of the members with a concrete, observable, decidable mechanism. Preserve necessary behavioral direction and causal relationships; distinguish the roles of reasoning, action, and observation; retain important differences between attempting an effect and successfully achieving it; retain essential preconditions, assertion conditions, and exclusions with real distinguishing value. Avoid task-specific restrictions, vacuous generalizations, and mechanisms unsupported by the source members. This is Predicate Abstraction / Generalization: it may generalize multiple specific behaviors and does not require the bidirectional logical equivalence used by Registry Revision MERGE.

All members belong to the same arity group. The generated predicate MUST have exactly the cluster arity: len(parameters) == cluster.arity. Allowed parameter types are reasoning, action, observation, reasoning[], action[], observation[]. A homogeneous collection parameter counts as one argument. Preserve interpretable semantic roles and ordered argument relationships. You may rename parameters to express the common mechanism. Parameter names must be distinct lower_snake_case identifiers.

Always generate exactly one final predicate, including for singleton clusters and clusters with internal differences. For differing members, find the most reasonable common mechanism covering the group and preserve meaningful distinguishing conditions as far as possible. Never declare the members incompatible or impossible to merge. Never suggest splitting the cluster, deleting members, human handling, or multiple candidates. Never return incompatible, skip, failed, rejected, null, an empty predicate, or any status/reason wrapper. Do not add evaluation scores or explanations.

Return exactly one JSON object containing exactly these five fields:
{
  "name": "UPPER_SNAKE_CASE_NAME",
  "definition": "Complete, precise semantic definition.",
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "parameter_name",
      "type": "reasoning",
      "description": "Precise ordered argument role."
    }
  ],
  "assertion_conditions": ["Explicit observable condition."],
  "exclusion_conditions": ["Distinguishing exclusion condition."]
}
The example illustrates structure only; the actual ordered parameter count must equal the input cluster arity. The predicate name must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE and must not conflict with any previously generated predicate name. Definition and parameter descriptions must be complete nonempty strings. Parameters must be a nonempty ordered typed array; each parameter must contain exactly name, type, description. Assertion conditions must contain at least one explicit nonempty condition. Exclusion conditions may be an empty array. Neither condition list may contain duplicates. Use English for all text. Output JSON only, with no Markdown or additional text.

message.reasoning_content:
We need answer JSON only. Need craft predicate abstraction for conflict resolution observation reasoning action. Need unique name not in list. Cluster ternary. Need exactly 3 parameters, types observation, reasoning, action. Name upper snake. Definition precise. Assertion/exclusion. Need generalize competing alternative contents/conflict unresolved and reasoning selects/determines resolution with justification/strategy, action applies edits/overwrites artifact consistent. Need common mechanism. Need preserve differences: selection version vs targeted edit; reasoning explicit justification vs determines strategy/replacement content. General definition can say observed conflict among competing alternatives in artifact, reasoning determines/selects resolution with justification/strategy/replacement content, action modifies/applies selected resolution. Assertion includes identifiable conflict, reasoning specifies chosen resolution with reason or replacement content, action applies consistently. Exclusions: no conflict, reasoning only notes conflict without determining, action unrelated/different, no justification/strategy? The second doesn't require justification? It says determines how conflict resolved incl replacement content. first requires justification. For common, maybe reasoning must provide identifiable resolution determination (selection rationale or replacement content/strategy). Exclusion "reasoning neither selects nor determines resolution". Could include "no justification for selection when selecting among alternatives"? But second may not explicitly justify. Better: "reasoning fails to identify which alternative is adopted or what replacement content/strategy resolves conflict." "only notes conflict without determining resolution." Also exclusion action discusses but no action.

Need name unique. Maybe "RESOLVES_OBSERVED_ARTIFACT_CONFLICT_VIA_REASONED_SELECTION_AND_APPLICATION"? Too long but okay. Or "RESOLVES_OBSERVED_CONFLICT_WITH_REASONED_ALTERNATIVE_APPLICATION". Must not conflict with existing. Let's choose "RESOLVES_OBSERVED_ARTIFACT_CONFLICT_VIA_REASONED_RESOLUTION_ACTION" maybe. UPPER_SNAKE only. Need JSON five fields exactly. Parameters names can retain conflict_observation, resolution_reasoning, resolution_action or generalize. distinct. Good.

Need ensure assertion conditions explicit observable. Let's craft concise but complete.

Definition: "An observation identifies unresolved or competing content alternatives for a target artifact; reasoning determines a resolution by selecting an alternative or specifying replacement content/strategy with an identifiable basis; an action edits, overwrites, adopts, stages, or commits the artifact so that the observed conflict is resolved in accordance with that determination." This covers both.

Parameters:
conflict_observation observation: observation reporting conflicting/competing alternatives, markers/status for target artifact.
resolution_reasoning reasoning: reasoning selecting alternative or specifying resolution strategy/replacement content and basis.
resolution_action action: action modifying/adopting overwriting artifact consistent with determination.

Assertion:
- conflict_observation contains identifiable unresolved conflict/competing content alternatives for same artifact.
- resolution_reasoning selects an alternative or specifies replacement content/resolution strategy with identifiable basis such as precedence/correctness/supersession (for selection) or explicit determined resolution.
- resolution_action modifies/overwrites/adopts/stages/commits target artifact in accordance with reasoning and removes/applies resolution to conflict.
Could mention consistency.

Exclusions:
- observation no identifiable conflict/competing versions.
- reasoning only notes/describes conflict without selecting alternative or determining resolution.
- reasoning selects/determines resolution but action unrelated to artifact or applies different resolution.
- conflict only discussed/described no action applying resolution.
- no basis? For selection? Need avoid excluding second? But if reasoning specifies replacement content, basis is spec. Maybe "For a selection among alternatives, no justification or identifying basis is provided" is okay. But common? We can include only if source first has exclusion no justification. Second exclusion doesn't include. Since abstraction can retain. But if output excludes cases where reasoning determines strategy without justification? Hmm. It says "The reasoning states which alternative is adopted and gives an identifiable semantic reason such as precedence..." first. Second "specifies a resolution strategy or replacement content". So common requires "identifiable resolution determination" not necessarily verbal rationale; action can apply. Exclusion "The reasoning provides no identifiable selection, replacement content, or strategy that determines the resolution." Enough.

Need output JSON only no markdown. Ensure all fields exactly.

parsed_response.name: RESOLVES_OBSERVED_ARTIFACT_CONFLICT_VIA_REASONED_RESOLUTION_ACTION
parsed_response.definition: An observation identifies unresolved or competing content alternatives for a target artifact; reasoning determines how the conflict is to be resolved by selecting one alternative or specifying replacement content or a resolution strategy with an identifiable basis; and an action modifies, overwrites, adopts, stages, or commits the artifact so that the observed conflict is resolved in accordance with that reasoned determination.

parameters.name: conflict_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting unresolved conflict, conflict markers or status, or otherwise competing content alternatives for the same target artifact.

parameters.name: resolution_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that determines the resolution by selecting a competing alternative or specifying replacement content, a resolution strategy, or both, with an identifiable basis for that determination.

parameters.name: resolution_action
parameters.description: The action that edits, overwrites, adopts, stages, or commits the target artifact so as to apply the reasoned resolution to the observed conflict.

assertion_conditions: The conflict_observation contains identifiable unresolved conflict or competing content alternatives for the same target artifact.

The resolution_reasoning selects one alternative or specifies replacement content or a resolution strategy that determines how the conflict is to be resolved, with an identifiable basis such as precedence, correctness, supersession, or explicit replacement content.
The resolution_action modifies, overwrites, adopts, stages, or commits the target artifact in accordance with the resolution determined by the reasoning.
exclusion_conditions: The conflict_observation does not contain an identifiable conflict or competing content alternatives for the target artifact.
The resolution_reasoning only notes or describes the conflict without selecting an alternative or determining replacement content or a resolution strategy.
The resolution_action is unrelated to the conflicted artifact or applies a different resolution than the one determined by the reasoning.
The conflict is only discussed or described without any action applying a resolution.
The reasoning provides no identifiable selection, replacement content, or strategy that determines the resolution.
